## Blog and weekly AI analysis
- AI Under Scrutiny: Regulation, Memory, and the Illusion of Progress: https://jonathan-harris.online/blog/posts/2026-w15-ai-under-scrutiny-regulation-memory-and-the-illusion-of-progress/ — This week, AI development faces increased regulatory pressure in Washington, while advancements in AI memory and topic modelling are met with scepticism. Concerns about governance, open-source principles, and the limitations of AI agents temper the enthusiasm surrounding new technologies.
